California State Water Resources Control Board

Surface Water - Freshwater Harmful Algal Blooms

Freshwater harmful algal bloom (HAB) data are sourced from the Freshwater Harmful Algal Bloom (FHAB) data system. The FHAB data system is the California State Water Resources Control Board’s platform for data and information voluntarily reported to the agency. Bloom reports are voluntary submissions from the public or organizations to identify a potential HAB for evaluation. These reports may or may not represent a confirmed HAB; however, all bloom reports are published.

Because the information is voluntarily provided, the database may include waterbody names and locations, potential bloom locations and observed characteristics, field observations and/or analytical sampling results, waterbody and/or land management details, general information, recommended advisory status (if any), and updates regarding bloom status. For additional information about this dataset, refer to the Data Dictionary and Data Disclaimer.

For more information and data visualizations, please visit the Water Boards HABs website: https://mywaterquality.ca.gov/habs/.
